index_event: First-ever diagnosis of type 2 diabetes (the first recorded diagnosis of type 2 diabetes in the patient's medical record)
inclusion_criteria: Diagnosis must be the patient’s first-ever recorded diagnosis of type 2 diabetes.
exclusion_criteria: Any diagnosis of type 1 diabetes recorded before the index date.
observation_window: Post-index follow-up from the index date until the end of the patient’s continuous observation (end of available medical/insurance records).

demographics.age: Adults aged 18 years and older at index date

prior_observation: No prior continuous observation required before index.
cohort_exit: Exit at end of continuous observation (end of available records).
